posts.text: This isn’t really a criticism, but it occurs to me that “quietly deleted” is now the established phrasing for clearing old posts without issuing some kind of formal statement about it. Never mind that deleting stuff doesn’t make a sound. And telling the world you’re deleting stuff you don’t want to call attention to (which is why you’re deleting it!) would be weird.
